|errata_history=This is the AI (alternate image) printing; the image is the Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB8-L-errantventureai-pre.gif]], undated), which prints the current title •Errant Venture and the current text (the base card's PC-E1). No AI printing under the old title •Booster's Star Destroyer (V) is known: the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet has no AI slip, the archived PC website card lists (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) have no row for an AI card, and the Master List (27 April 2013) has no AI slip either<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49, page 49. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49 Internet Archive]</ref>. So this printing has one version. The base card's versions are [[Booster's Star Destroyer (V)]] (original) and [[Errant Venture]] (PC-E1, current).
* '''AI''' (this page): Players Committee AI card image, undated: “May add 6 pilots. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, once per game may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] scoundrel aboard and while Corran or a Terrik piloting, immune to attrition < 7.”
